candidates.decision_relevance: Would test whether settled ETF breadth and flows confirmed or contradicted the proxy breadth and price-based warning narratives.
candidates.evidence_reference: W35-W37 weekly adversarial reviews; daily outputs repeatedly cite stale or unavailable settled ETF context.
candidates.metric_name: Settled BTC/ETH ETF flow and breadth sequence
candidates.missing_history_problem: Only isolated, stale settled sessions are available; within-week sequencing, persistence, concentration, and lead-lag versus breadth and drawdowns cannot be checked.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would establish whether breadth, leadership, liquidity, microstructure, leverage, and liquidations deteriorated before or after price weakness, separating leading evidence from drawdown consequences.
candidates.evidence_reference: W34-W37 reviews and daily outputs repeatedly identify missing timestamp order and incomplete pullback/liquidation sequences.
candidates.missing_history_problem: The record provides endpoint summaries and lower-bound liquidation snapshots but not a cutoff-clean, continuous event sequence with source timestamps and completeness status.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would distinguish narrow ETH/BTC relative strength from broad participation and test whether breadth expansion or deterioration persisted through subsequent price moves.
candidates.evidence_reference: W35-W37 reviews and daily outputs state that breadth is proxy-only, point-in-time, membership-changing, or unavailable in settled form.
candidates.missing_history_problem: Top-100 proxy observations cannot establish persistence, universe comparability, large-cap participation, or diversified leadership across the relevant episodes.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would test whether supportive liquidity was actually deployed and transmitted into market participation, rather than relying on supply context alone.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily outputs repeatedly state that stablecoin supply is available only as context and deployment/transmission is unavailable.
candidates.metric_name: Stablecoin deployment and market-liquidity transmission series
candidates.missing_history_problem: Supply changes are not accompanied by exchange, market-cap, turnover, or breadth transmission history, leaving constructive liquidity and failed-transmission interpretations observationally confounded.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would independently verify drawdown timing, recovery magnitude, cross-asset divergence, and whether late-week recovery invalidated the earlier warning interpretation.
candidates.evidence_reference: W33-W37 reviews state that raw 168-hour BTC, ETH, and ETH/BTC paths are absent or only summarized by endpoints.
candidates.metric_name: Raw BTC, ETH, and ETH/BTC hourly price paths
candidates.missing_history_problem: Endpoint and rolling-return descriptions cannot independently verify the intraperiod path, drawdown ordering, recovery durability, or overlap among supposedly separate observations.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would permit ex-ante audit of forecast precision, hindsight leakage, range containment, horizon alignment, and matured false-positive or false-negative outcomes.
candidates.evidence_reference: All weekly reviews report three prior candidates but omit their objects; reviews also report null or zero matured outcome and exit-calibration rows.
candidates.missing_history_problem: Issue times, evidence cutoffs, metric paths, bounds, thresholds, confidence, and realized outcomes are unavailable, so candidate quality and exit-warning calibration cannot be scored.
